# Adyber — Digital Marketing & Creative Agency

> Adyber is a premier digital marketing, web development, and AI automation agency based in Dehradun and Haridwar, Uttarakhand, India. We help startups, local businesses, and fast-growing brands scale with high-converting websites, result-driven search engine optimization (SEO), branding, and custom automated systems.

## Core Offerings & Services
1. **Website Development**: High-performance, responsive marketing sites, web applications, and custom UI/UX design built with React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.
2. **Local & Global Search Engine Optimization (SEO)**: Keyword targeting, Google Business Profile optimization, technical SEO, and link-building to rank #1 locally for "marketing agency near me" in Dehradun, Haridwar, and regional hubs.
3. **Personalised AI Automations**: Workflow automation, AI agent integration, CRM sync, and operational efficiency tools designed to save time and scale operations.
4. **Social Media Management**: Strategic content scheduling, graphic asset creation, brand storytelling, and audience engagement across platforms.
5. **Branding & Visual Identity**: Custom logo design, brand typography, color palettes, tone of voice guidelines, and high-impact visual collateral.
6. **Business Consulting**: Actionable strategy, market analysis, and scale-up roadmaps for startups.
